title: Camping, Overlanding & RV Hour-of-Day Activity Heatmap
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=victron:telemetry
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day most camping, overlanding events typically arrive.
value: Hour-of-day patterns expose automation schedules, commute windows, and habits that are easy to miss in daily totals alone.
implementation: Ingest `victron:telemetry` with accurate `_time` values and chart hourly counts to see when the feed is naturally busy or quiet.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of event count by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your camping, overlanding data is usually busiest so you can spot routines that moved or feeds that went quiet at the wrong hour.
